evidence_items.explanation: The denial concerns degradation undertaken to serve demand. It does not deny that users could experience regressions from bugs or other product changes.

evidence_items.explanation: The original report and accompanying log analysis substantiate that users reported serious degradation. The observational analysis does not establish why Anthropic made changes or isolate demand as the cause.

The retrospective account identifies reasoning-default, caching, and prompt changes affecting Claude products before publication, while distinguishing the API. Its stated causes concern latency, software errors, and verbosity; this is relevant counterevidence to demand attribution but is not an independent audit.

unresolved_gaps: No independently verified deployment or decision record establishes that the relevant regressions were introduced to serve demand.
The company account does not independently exclude additional causes or establish the experience of every affected user.
The documented complaints are not a representative survey of the user base.
